Explain why a square encloses the most area among rectangles of a given perimeter.
items.answer: As a rectangle's shape becomes more elongated, one dimension grows while the other shrinks, lowering the product (area); the area is greatest when the sides are equal, which is the square.

steps: Equal sides maximize the area product.
